title: A validation failure sends field paths and nothing else
outcome: A failure only the server can detect can point at the field that caused it, without putting auto-generated English or schema shape on the wire.
acceptanceCriteria: serializeError maps ValidationError.details to field paths only. The message, expected, minimum, origin and unrecognized-key fields do not leave the server.
details stays an array of paths rather than becoming a map: one field can fail more than one rule, and a map would silently drop the second.

A test drives a real request through a route schema and asserts the serialized issue carries the path and no other key. Asserting against a hand-built issue object would not catch what zod actually emits, which is how the input field was misread during scoping.
The client type declares details as paths, so a consumer cannot reach for a message that is no longer sent.
